facilities.name: RASUN RESTAURANT
facilities.description: Rasun is a restaurant dedicated to celebrating the rich and vibrant flavours of traditional Bangla cuisine. At Rasun, we offer an authentic culinary experience, featuring time-honoured recipes prepared with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Guests can enjoy a warm and inviting dine-in experience or opt for the convenience of takeaway, ensuring a delightful experience with every meal. Beyond dining, Rasun serves as an excellent venue for hosting parties and celebrations, providing the perfect setting for creating unforgettable memories.

facilities.name: GYM
facilities.description: Our fitness centre is equipped with a range of modern exercise machines and free weights, providing an inviting space for all our guests. Whether you want to energize your morning or unwind after a busy day, our gym offers a comfortable and motivating environment. At Hotel Shuktara Dhaka, we ensure your stay is well-balanced, seamlessly blending relaxation, fitness, and luxury.

facilities.name: CONFERENCE ROOM
facilities.description: Hotel Shuktara Dhaka provides a professional and fully-equipped conference room ideal for hosting corporate meetings and events. Designed with modern business needs in mind, our conference room offers a comfortable and sophisticated setting, complete with high-speed internet, audio-visual equipment, and flexible seating arrangements. Whether you're planning a board meeting, training session, or corporate seminar, our dedicated staff is on hand to ensure everything runs smoothly.
